SS-VALIDATION.Purpose: Give humans and coding agents high-signal executable evidence for FLI invariants and user paths, and define the release-confidence process.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Architecture tests enforcing thin integrations and dependency direction.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Core scenario/contract/generative tests; integration tests and cross-harness parity; end-to-end packaged-product tests; release/offline/reproducibility/cleanliness tests.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Semantic evals: schema conformance, Codemap fidelity, ownership/duplication, uncertainty behavior.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Weakening or redefining FLI semantics to pass evals.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Unit-test coverage metrics and raw test count as confidence metrics.

Principles.PRIN-001: The knowledge graph is the semantic authority for test obligations; the verification plane states them explicitly.
Principles.PRIN-002: Generative/property/model-based coverage over manual enumeration of equivalent cases where a stable property exists.
Principles.PRIN-003: Every discovered defect becomes a regression obligation before or with repair when practical.
Principles.PRIN-004: Semantic quality is not deterministic correctness; clean project stays unchanged; ambiguous evidence fails closed.

Requirements.REQ-001: Architecture tests enforce Core !-> Integrations and that integrations use supported Core surfaces without duplicating declaration parsing, selector Resolution, or root inference.
Requirements.REQ-002: The canonical Agent Skill has one harness-independent owner and no integration-local semantic forks; the default package exposes Core plus the canonical skill.
Requirements.REQ-003: Core ancestor tests cover: no-declaration file -> empty context; literal nearest-upward resolution; recursive/transitive parents; multiple parents; cycles; invalid/missing targets; symlinks; filesystem-root termination; no downward/full scan; no glob acceptance.
Requirements.REQ-004: Core graph tests cover: anchor without declaration does not participate; boundary priority explicit root -> nearest `.frostline` -> nearest `.git` -> top-level child of `HOME`; HOME itself never full-scanned; unsafe/no inferred boundary -> diagnostic; one bounded full scan; external parent ancestry included without scanning external subtrees; additions/deletions/cache rebuild; ignored/untracked participation independence.
Requirements.REQ-005: Selector tests prove every glob/wildcard/brace/class/escape form is rejected and literal selectors remain deterministic.
Requirements.REQ-006: Cache/state tests prove derived-state removal or corruption changes performance/reinjection only, never semantic truth; delivery tests prove one scope may traverse unrelated filesystem scopes without path collision.
Requirements.REQ-007: Knowledge schema tests cover tier matrix conformance, statement prefix/numbering validation, FQID target resolution, and Codemap CDATA constraints.
Requirements.REQ-008: Tests must not mutate user configuration/environment outside a controlled sandbox; test output/log/temp state is cleaned.
Requirements.REQ-009: E2E: built package -> realistic temporary scope -> observable FLI user path; bundled assets resolve without development-only overrides.
Requirements.REQ-010: Release: self-contained/offline, deterministic complete manifest, no undeclared runtime dependency, clean filesystem behavior; release gates include canonical skill projection/registration and no Session Start semantic prompt.
Requirements.REQ-011: Current release target: Codex, Linux x86_64; local/manual release checks are acceptable; a CI provider is not an architectural requirement.
Requirements.REQ-012: Repository dogfooding: every `docs/*.xml` node passes `validateKnowledge`; the docs graph is a DAG with tier order M -> SS -> S -> P; role mapping holds (packages/** -> M, tests/** -> V, integrations/** -> M|SS); every scenario `target` FQID resolves to an existing statement; every <File> in <TestFiles> exists.
